decisions.reason: As a core formwork-profile product with its own web presence and close fit to the firm's modular factory solutions, it is likely to remain in the portfolio.
The shuttering magnet block fits the established precast formwork range, but as a more accessory-like item with only limited website prominence it faces some rationalization risk.
This magnetic formwork component had its own product page and supports the firm's integrated precast production offering, so management would usually continue it unless demand proved weak.
